title: Throat of the Machine
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A talking sawtooth bass in the low register whose vowel slowly morphs through a-e-o-u, giving it a roaring, vocal-ish character. FM grit, a band-pass sweep and a deep slow vibrato all travel on separate clocks so the loop never sits still over its ~32 second arc.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 [c1 eb1] g1 <f1 g0>>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e o u>/8")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1, 6)).fmh("<1 1.5 2>/6")
    .penv("<0 0 9 -4>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.07)
    .bpf(sine.slow(17).range(180, 1600)).resonance(14).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .shape(sine.slow(32).range(0.2, 0.5))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.07)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).vowel("<e i>/4"))
    .room(0.2).delay("0.3:0.375:0.5").gain(0.9)
)
